info.name: Select Star Metadata bi custom-attribute-values API

params.name: asset_type
params.description: A comma separated value for asset type in form: data_source_type,object_type,data_type

params.name: custom_attributes
params.description: A comma separated list of custom attribute guids to get their custom attribute values.

params.name: datasources
params.description: Filter custom attributes values by a data source guid

params.name: items
params.description: Filter custom attributes values by a item guids, that values are assigned for

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

items.docs:
This endpoint retrieves a list of all values for a specific custom attribute.
      If a list of object GUIDs is provided (via the 'items' parameter),
      it will return all values for that custom attribute across the provided objects.

**Required Role:** Viewer or higher

Use this endpoint when you need to assign a value to a specific custom attribute tied to a specific object.
        This endpoint is used to update a custom attribute's value as it applies to a specific object.
        It's meant for individual updates, modifying only one custom attribute value at a time.
        Default behavior dictates, that values are plaintext.

This endpoint is for reading the value of a custom attribute itself.
          The GUID in the URL corresponds to the value of the custom attribute, which is linked to its textual
          content and the object it is attached to.

**Required Role:** Viewer or higher

This endpoint is designed for modifying an existing
                value and/or rich text value of a custom attribute on a particular object.

**Required Role:** Data Manager or higher
